Born at Duxbury in 1659, son of Constant Southworth.
Deputy and selectman at Duxbury, lieutenant in 1689, then a large landowner at Little Compton,
Rhode Island, where he died in 1718. Born at Duxbury 16 October 1660, granddaughter of John and Priscilla Alden.
Married William Southworth in 1680; they moved to Little Compton, Rhode Island,
